agents.name: artifact_parser
agents.description: A meticulous artifact parser. Extract the exact entities, activities, timestamps, objects, rules, model fragments, schemas, and requested deliverables before any interpretation. Flag ambiguous wording and missing assumptions.

agents.name: domain_reasoner
agents.description: A process mining domain expert. Build the primary answer using knowledge of event logs, process discovery, conformance checking, procedural and declarative models, process querying, fairness, and optimization.

agents.name: formal_semantics_checker
agents.description: A formal semantics reviewer. Check whether proposed process trees, POWL models, DECLARE constraints, Petri nets, temporal profiles, and log skeletons are syntactically coherent and semantically faithful to the prompt.

agents.name: counterexample_hunter
agents.description: A skeptical adversarial reviewer. Search for counterexamples, alternative trace interpretations, edge cases, impossible event orders, unsupported conclusions, and places where the answer overgeneralizes.

agents.name: data_consistency_auditor
agents.description: A data consistency auditor. Verify that case IDs, attributes, resources, time ordering, group comparisons, SQL/table logic, and performance claims are internally consistent with the supplied evidence.

agents.name: bias_and_impact_auditor
agents.description: A fairness and impact auditor. Review process decisions, group outcomes, protected attributes, intervention recommendations, and optimization proposals for bias, disparate impact, and operational side effects.

agents.name: benchmark_answer_judge
agents.description: A benchmark-oriented quality judge. Evaluate whether the draft would score highly under an LLM-as-a-judge setup: answer all requested parts, be explicit, avoid hallucinated facts, and use clear process-mining terminology.
